feed.headline: Why U.S. Business Deals Are Unlikely to Get Putin to Give Any Ground
feed.ai: President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia has shown a willingness to endure a high price to get what he wants in Ukraine, and he sees little reason to stop fighting now, analysts say.

feed.headline: Emotional reunions with loved ones for Oleshky evacuees
feed.ai: The BBC's Dan Johnson travelled to the northern Ukrainian border with Belarus after evacuated Oleshky residents arrived in buses and ambulances following a temporary ceasefire.

feed.headline: Egypt reopens Tripoli embassy after 12 years and raises concerns over Turkey-Libya maritime deal
feed.ai: Egypt is seeking closer ties with Libya’s western government after years of backing its eastern rival. Talks in Tripoli covered energy projects and Egypt’s objections to Libya’s maritime deal with Turkey.

feed.headline: Iran delivers secret Khamenei message to Putin as Moscow pushes gas pipeline deal
feed.ai: Iran’s Security Council chief, Mohsen Rezaei, went to Moscow to deliver a personal message from Ayatollah Khamenei and discuss building a pipeline to import Russian gas.

feed.headline: PSNI to support gardaí amid huge security operation for EU meetings
feed.ai: Irish police say it is going to be the largest security operation in the history of the state.

feed.headline: Andy Burnham wants to get closer to the EU - but he shouldn't expect a smooth ride
feed.ai: Laura Kuenssberg talks to government insiders about the prime minister opening the conversation about the UK rejoining the EU.

feed.headline: Meghan Markle Makes First Public Appearance Since Her Father’s Arrest
feed.ai: The Duchess of Sussex accompanied her husband, Prince Harry, in Brussels at an event about online safety for children.

feed.headline: Turkey Promotes Itself as a Climate Champion. Not Everyone Agrees.
feed.ai: Critics say some of the country’s environmental policies run counter to the image it is offering as host of a United Nations climate summit.

feed.headline: Germans Miss Merkel, Their Old Chancellor, Though They Dislike Her Policies
feed.ai: Crowds have flocked to the stern, but reassuring, face of Angela Merkel in her official portrait, even as a backlash to her legacy roils German politics.

feed.headline: Belgium: Prince Harry and Meghan visit EU Parliament for child safety event
feed.ai: Prince Harry and his wife Meghan visited the European Parliament in Brussels, on Tuesday 10 November, to discuss the dangers children face online. The couple met families affected by online abuse before Harry addressed the gathering.

feed.headline: Poland: Tusk and Nawrocki honour six victims of Kraków shooting
feed.ai: Poland's President and Prime Minister set aside their political differences to honour the six victims of a deadly shooting in Kraków. The two leaders laid candles and knelt together at a vigil in the historic city centre.

feed.headline: Turkey: Delegates arrive in Antalya as COP31 climate talks begin
feed.ai: The United Nations COP31 climate summit has opened in Antalya after a year marked by deadly heatwaves and devastating floods. Delegates face fresh challenges as the war in Iran disrupts global energy supplies.
